plan: Given my value of $40, I'll bid slightly below to ensure a profit if I win. Assuming others bid close to their values, I'll bid $35 to increase my chances of winning while ensuring a profit margin. If others bid higher, I lose nothing. If I win, I pay the third-highest bid, likely lower than $35, ensuring profit.

Given my value of $13, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly above average, anticipating others may bid close to their values. If I bid $13, I win if others bid below this, paying the third-highest bid. If I bid too high, I risk overpaying. If I bid too low, I miss potential profit. A bid around $12.5 is strategic, balancing the chance of winning with minimizing overpayment.

Given my value of $17, I aim to bid low enough to ensure profit if I win but high enough to outbid others. I anticipate others to bid around their values. If I bid $10, I may win if others bid below $10, paying the third-highest bid and ensuring profit. If both bid above $10, I lose but incur no cost. This strategy balances risk and potential profit.
